title: Tinman driver protocol message
description: One newline-delimited JSON message exchanged with the Tinman driver on stdin and stdout. A client in any language needs only a subprocess and a JSON parser. Referenced by features/driver-protocol.feature.

request.description: A message from the test runner to the driver.

id.description: Client-assigned request identifier, echoed on the reply.

session.description: The session the operation addresses. Absent on launch.

command.description: The target command, on a launch request.

sandbox.description: Backend-neutral sandbox specification for the session, on a launch request.

within.description: Restricts a locator to the named region.

response.description: A reply from the driver to the test runner.

id.description: The identifier of the request being answered.

ok.description: Whether the operation succeeded. A failed action is a reply, never a dropped session.

error.description: Why the operation failed. Present when ok is false.

screen.description: The virtual screen, present when the failure or the operation reports one.

items.description: Structured data returned by a capture.
